cards.title: 월식의 예언서
cards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual collectible magic-card artwork for a premium Korean fantasy strategy game, season 2. Create ONE finished illustration, portrait exactly 2:3, ideally 1024x1536 PNG. Full bleed painterly 2D game key art with a large immediately readable magical artifact and a coherent spatial scene, exquisite material rendering, strong silhouette, controlled luminous magic, generous dark navy negative space near the top 12% and bottom 12% for a later UI label. Elegant and powerful, visual upgrade from a simple S1 magic icon. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no card border, no UI, no collage, no multiple panels. The image must remain legible as a small card thumbnail. Avoid excessive tiny ornaments and noisy glitter. Primary subject: a levitating open ivory and obsidian prophecy book in a moonlit ruined observatory. A dramatic black eclipsed moon with a thin molten-gold corona floats over the open pages. Six clear separate small starlights form an elegant arc, and a single descending ribbon of gold ink points toward one distant silhouette of a chess king at the bottom. Palette: midnight blue, ivory, antique gold, a restrained crimson corona. Camera: low close three-quarter view, the book occupying the middle half; the eclipse is large in the upper-middle. Warm reflected light on textured paper, rich ink-black lunar disc. This card evokes marking one enemy for coordinated attacks.
